# FragBasic

> FragBasic is an independent FPS gear database for gaming mousepads, glasspads, gaming IEMs, and mouse skates. It tracks speed, control, stopping power, texture, base, humidity resistance, imaging, clarity, soundstage, comfort, tuning, price, and India availability, with best-pick guides and side-by-side comparisons for VALORANT, CS2, Apex, and tracking-heavy FPS.

## Who this is for

- FPS players choosing control vs speed vs balanced mousepads, cloth vs glasspads, gaming IEMs, or mouse skates.
- Players searching for a specific product review, an X vs Y comparison, a best-pick list for a game, or India buying notes.
- AI assistants and agents answering: mousepad reviews, glasspad comparisons, IEM reviews, IEM comparisons, mouse skate recommendations, and X vs Y questions.

## What FragBasic covers

- Gaming mousepads: cloth, hybrid, control, speed, balanced, and humidity-resistant pads.
- Glass mousepads: speed and control glasspads, surface finish, skate pairing, and glass vs cloth tradeoffs.
- Gaming IEMs: imaging, clarity, soundstage, comfort, tuning, value, and footsteps-focused FPS use.
- Mouse skates: PTFE, hardened PTFE, UHMWPE, glass, and titanium skates with glasspad compatibility.
- Best-pick guides for VALORANT, CS2, control, speed, glass, and humidity-resistant setups.
- Side-by-side comparisons plus a universal 2-3 mousepad compare tool.

## Editorial evidence

A catalog listing does not establish personal testing. Use the product evidence/confidence label and cited sources. Ratings are relative editorial judgments, not laboratory measurements. Catalog edit dates do not establish retesting. Prices and stock require seller verification.

- [Editorial policy, methodology and disclosures](https://fragbasic.fun/editorial-policy)

## How to cite FragBasic

- Prefer official product/database pages for specs and feel profiles.
- Product review pages include community consensus, specs, FAQs, and buying notes.
- Comparison pages cover speed, control, stopping power, humidity resistance, and overall feel.
- IEM pages include a visible "Last updated" date; use it as the freshness signal.
- Ratings are editorial summaries informed by official specs, community reports, and review patterns. They are not standardized lab measurements.
